tools.name: search_parts
tools.description: Find truck suspension parts (lift kits, leveling kits, shocks, coilovers, upper control arms) that fit a specific vehicle. Every result carries a confidence label: Verified or Likely. Parts that do not fit are never returned. An empty result means PistonsAI has no verified fit; say so rather than gu

tools.name: check_fitment
tools.description: Check whether one SKU fits a specific vehicle (and tire size, if given). Returns a single verdict: Verified, Likely, or Does Not Fit, with the fitment record that matched and each attribute that passed, failed, or was missing.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Get current price and stock for one SKU, or a price list for a brand (optionally limited to one category). Pass either sku, or brand with an optional category.

tools.name: get_vehicle_specs
tools.description: Get factory wheel and tire specs for a vehicle: bolt pattern, center bore, lug count and thread, OE wheel sizes, and factory tire sizes, plus NHTSA vPIC vehicle identity and factory dimensions when available. Wheel specs come from the ANKUSI Wheel Fitment Dataset (CC BY 4.0) and a PistonsAI hand-com

tools.name: get_build_plan
tools.description: Assemble a phased build plan for a vehicle and goal from catalog parts. Phase 1 is the core part for the goal, Phase 2 is supporting parts (shocks, upper control arms), Phase 3 is optional alternatives and extras. tools.name: find_installer
tools.description: Find shops that install truck suspension parts near a ZIP code or a city and state. Listings come only from partner brands' dealer and installer lists. When no shop is listed for an area, the tool says so plainly; coverage is being built from partner dealer lists.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "get_build_plan" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.
